DESCRIPTION:
Upgrade a nArchitecture 1.x solution to 2.0 (.NET 10, Core.Mediator, Mapperly)

USAGE:
    nArchGen.dll upgrade [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    nArchGen.dll upgrade --dry-run
    nArchGen.dll upgrade --project exampleProject

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -p, --project                Project folder under src/ (auto-detected when  
                                 there is only one)                             
        --dry-run                Analyze and write MIGRATION-REPORT.md without  
                                 changing any file                              
        --keep-test-framework    Keep xunit 2 / VSTest instead of moving tests  
                                 to xunit.v3 + Microsoft Testing Platform       
        --no-build               Do not restore and build after applying the    
                                 changes                                        
        --skip                   Comma separated step ids to skip:              
                                 project-files, mediator, automapper, tests,    
                                 web-api, format, verify                        
        --force                  Run even when the git working tree has         
                                 uncommitted changes
